scriptedVariables.name: sfEventType
scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>{if(obj==null)return undefined;if(/^\d+$/.test(key)&&Array.isArray(obj))return obj[Number(key)];return obj[key];},root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};const raw=String(read('eventType','event_type','type','action','operation','event.reason')||'').toLowerCase();if(raw.includes('hire')||raw.includes('create')||raw==='insert'||raw==='employee.created')return 'employee.created';return raw;

scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>obj==null?undefined:obj[key],root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};return read('employeeId','personIdExternal','userId','employee.employeeId','employee.personIdExternal','employment.personIdExternal','payload.employeeId');

scriptedVariables.name: employeeDisplayName
scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>obj==null?undefined:obj[key],root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};const direct=read('displayName','employee.displayName','userNav.displayName','person.displayName');if(direct)return direct;const name=[read('firstName','givenName','employee.firstName'),read('lastName','surname','employee.lastName')].filter(Boolean).join(' ');return name||read('employeeId','personIdExternal','userId')||'New employee';
